tokens.source: orchestrator_usage (two dispatches: 75,434 blocked-prereq run + 323,265 Opus build)

walltime: ~73m Opus build (plus an earlier blocked run; spans session-limit interruptions)
notes: THE COMPOSITE (queue A5, GRU track) and the largest single block in the catalog: 51 cells = one full GRU timestep (H=4, I=2) + a 4-class linear readout head, recurrence entirely INTERNAL. There is NO GNU Radio counterpart and there cannot be one (a GRC flowgraph is acyclic), so the golden is the chip-exact integer model in examples/gru_classifier/ml/gru_reference_chip, asserted word-equal to the block's own reference. Structure: ONE closed 7x8 ring serpentine (FLL column-pair fold) - fin (timestep-barrier LOCK) -> hstr -> 16 uniform MAC-row walk cells -> per-unit SHARED sigmoid + tanh engines (activation_blocks builders imported verbatim, the AGCCC shared-builder model) -> counting-join unit math -> blend -> h' collector -> 4 head rows at ONE COMMON scale -> signed running argmax -> off-ring egress relay; unlock via a ring-forward WRITE.CFG from the chain END. VERIFIED 2-LEVEL ON CHIP (52 tests): the h TRAJECTORY read out of the umB{i} cells' pinned hs state registers is BIT-EXACT vs the golden (3 random seeds + 12 real clips across all 4 classes), and 36000 on-chip timesteps agree with the golden at 1.000000 (bar 0.99); the 120-clip end-to-end vote reads 0.9667 on chip == 0.9667 offline on the same clips. SATURATED == per-sample on the FIRST run - the timestep barrier bounds the recurrent ring to one timestep in flight, so the documented ~50-cell-macro-loop deadlock class never arose. State continuity across 4 back-to-back bursts proven on one live chip. ONE REAL BUG FOUND, by the 8-orientation gate: the layout dict is a POSITIONAL INDEX (the router resolves handoffs by pb.cells[program_keys.index(dst)]), so program cells must come first in program order with the face-only transits last, AND the external-egress relay must be the LAST program cell - otherwise the router's positional-default branch stays live for the egress port and traces the closed ring the LONG way round under the 180-degree orientations (44 > 31 hops, assembler reject). cw+cw and mirror_h+cw+cw failed to build; two plausible-looking fixes were tried and measured WRONG first (a __terminate__ declaration makes the cell an internal-handoff source and the face-reassert pass then kills the routed egress). Promoted to INV-35. Second durable finding: a decision-only mutation gate is nearly blind here - the random-feature class stream is near-constant and three mutants passed it while plainly broken; the mutation stimulus must be stitched from real clips of every class, and a single perturbed weight word is honestly reportable only at the STATE level (moves h on 239/240 steps, leaves every clip vote unchanged) so the accuracy-degradation claim is made with genuinely corrupted weights (37/40 -> 30/40). Also emitted the REQUIRED weight-location manifest (GRUCellBlock.weights.json, gru-cell-weight-map-v1, 104 named entries each asserted equal to the BUILT cell word). GRC binding: kyttar_gru_cell.block.yml + the gru_cell dsp_markers pass-through; weights_file is a PATH param so the binding stays at 5 params instead of ~104. (commit sha intentionally null: stamping it into a file that is part of the same commit is self-referential; the record's commit is the one that adds this file.) ORCHESTRATION HISTORY (for the dataset): first dispatch was BLOCKED by an orchestrator error - its isolation worktree branched from the stale public remote, so every landed prerequisite appeared missing; the builder verified the wall, refused to claim-and-wedge the queue row, refused to self-authorize a 5-block scope expansion, and spent the time on a useful numpy preview of the activation reconciliation (predicted 94.4%, measured 94.58%). Root cause fixed permanently (worktree.baseRef=head). Rebuilt on Opus after the Fable budget was exhausted; the accumulated findings (route-time face rule, phase-0 completion) were folded into the re-dispatch so the second run started past them.
